notes.title: v1.4.2 - Extended Fixes
notes.content:
[p]Hey y'all. Still cooking on the DLC and testing some camera shit while I chip away at Bane Murrain: Episode 2. There's more of a crossover between those things than you'd expect though![/p][p]Anyway, I've decided to drop some of the smaller fixes and polishes I've made while on the DLC grind.
[/p][p][b][u]Full Changelog: "V1.4.2 - Extended Fixes"[/u][/b][/p][p][i]New Shit:
[/i]- Holding down Space now speeds up dialogue text[/p][p][i]Bug Fixes:
[/i]- Fixed bug where bullets stopped dealing damage to player
- Fixed repeating slash animation bug when firing directly after a slash
- Widened floor strip on Moving Saws to stop clipping textures
- Fixed timer trigger collider for 'Club Moonshine', 'Sepulchre' & 'Ossuary Office'
- Covered a clipping-through-wall saw with a box in 'Sepulchre'[/p][p][i]Tweaks & Changes:[/i][/p][p]- Changed tutorial text to explain intentional reloading mechanics better
- Text box is now transparent by like 10% ish
- Text box no longer has a speech bubble point to prevent any confusion on who's talking
- Changed Enemy bullet rotation, collision scaling & travelling speed
- Changed look-speed for melee enemies for smoother, natural movement (and to prevent weird helicopter attacks)
- Enemy bullets are now destroyed upon collision with the player rather than passing through
- Enemy gunfire now uses a slightly lessened screen-flash effect compared to the player's
- Acid Water now uses it's own damage tag system rather than using enemy slash damage
- Circular saws now vanish upon completing a level
- Enemies now stop attacking once the player is dead
[/p][p]Have fun!
-Elias[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: v1.4 - Hard Mode & Extras
notes.content:
[p]Hey y'all! It's time for Third Person Shooter fest, so here's a small update I crammed out amidst my Bane Murrain work. The campaign has a harder [b]new game plus playthrough mode[/b], there's an [b]alternate Clive skin to unlock[/b] for beating it, and I threw in some of the [b]concept art too[/b] from the game's three-month development.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565023/7ecb9470f4adbaf1f7073d804b06a3b07c6bf376.png"][/img][/p][p][b][u]Full Changelog: "V1.4 - Hard Mode"[/u][/b][/p][p][i]New Shit:
[/i]- Added 'Hard Mode' Campaign option
- Added 'Hard Random' Campaign option
- New achievement for Hard Mode completion
- Level select has toggles to play in Hard Mode
- Added Wishlist link for upcoming DLC
- New unlockable Blue outfit for Clive (beat Hard Mode)
- Added some Concept Art pieces for your viewing pleasure[/p][p][i]Tweaks & Patches:
[/i]- Various menus have been shifted / rescaled to fit DLC options and extras
- Pressing Pause in the opening text crawl now skips to the tutorial
- Bullet scales have been tweaked slightly
- The start of 'Dragonbreath' is no longer an empty-ass Unity skybox[/p][p][/p][p][b]I'm continuing to work away at my larger-scale FPS game[/b]'s next episode lately and the writing for the whole game is nearly complete. The game also recently got a huge refurbishment update! [b]Check it out for more of MORTALITY DECOMP. KILLER's connected universe.

[/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2625340/Bane_Murrain/"][/dynamiclink]Okay that's all. Have fun![/p][p]-Elias[/p]

notes.title: v1.2 - Going Rogue
notes.content:
[b]Hey guys! You didn't think I was done, did you?[/b]
Sorry for the absence though, I was busy script writing and playing a certain Dark Ages themed game for a long amount of time.

[h2]THE GAME'S A ROGUELIKE NOW[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565023/add6b30d6a2cba8ba77f579a01c62076a5c95e4d.jpg[/img]
Play through endlessly shuffled levels with randomized modifiers to choose from, some good and some bad. [b]How far can you make it before you fail?[/b]
Rogue Mode also has some exclusive alternate versions of existing tracks, and two secret crossover levels from other Cuppakill titles that I won't spoil for you...

[h2]THERE'S ALSO A RANDOMIZER[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565023/7adc8fc789f9f025d39530bb0bb5fe22c58abd47.png[/img]
For the campaign addicts like myself who just want a new way to replay the game in order, there's also now a randomizer mode to shuffle about all the enemy placements each time you die!


[u]Full Changelog: "V1.2 - GOING ROGUE"[/u]

New Shit:
[i]- Added an endless 'Rogue Mode'
- Added a Randomizer Campaign playthrough
- 3 New alt version of tracks (Only in Rogue Mode)
- 2 Crossover Maps (Only in Rogue Mode)[/i]

Tweaks & Patches:
[i]- Sensitivity settings now have no maximum & minimum values
- Bumped number of max sounds at once from 32 to 100
- Camera Shake turns off when Player spawns to prevent perma-shaking bug[/i]

New Rogue Modifiers:
Pros
[i]- EXTRA HIT
- SLOW BULLETS
- SWIFTNESS
- QUICK DRAW
- LITTLE GUYS
- CHAIN REACTION
- DEMOLITION MAN
- BLASTED
- STICKY FINGERS
- DUAL SHOT[/i]
Cons
[i]- RAPID FIRE
- TOUGHER
- NESTING DOLL
- SUPER MEATY
- RANDOMIZER
- STAB VESTS
- THORN BARREL
- COSTLY STRIKE[/i]


[b]That's all for now! I'm gonna be focusing deeply on Bane Murrain from this point on, but I'll be adding to Clive's game every now and then whenever I get a boost to work on some of it.[/b]

I have more ideas in mind for Clive, but for now it's time to get back to the semi-sequel to this... There's more undead Altxyte creatures to deal with!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2625340/Bane_Murrain/

Stay Tuned, y'all.
- Elias

notes.title: v1.1 - Noir Mode & Tweaks
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Just a very small update to clear up some issues with the end boss fight, plus throw in a few extra things for the fun of it. I'm glad y'all have been enjoying the game so far, the response has been more than I'd expected!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45565023/ef464a6f6a4bc0a23d6181fbcc7e0129179a1f29.png[/img]

[b][u]Changelog: V1.1 - "Noir Mode & Tweaks"[/u][/b]
[i]New Shit:[/i]
- 'Noir Mode' Setting has been added, for a low-contrast greyscale mode!
- Hidden Trophy Type added for completing levels without firing a single bullet
- Polished out Cuppakill intro & added a trigger warning for flashing imnagery

[i]Tweaks & Patches:[/i]
- Enemies are now alerted when they've been shot in an idle state
- Fixed issue where level select PAR time trophy would be incorrect

[i]Boss Changes:[/i]
- Added sprite flashes to indicate Final Boss's weakpoint
- Gave Final Boss's bullet deflection a unique ricochet sound

[url=https://open.spotify.com/album/45hP4kzcKn4tUDGA8gqsrI]Alongside all of this, the game's soundtrack is now available on streaming too![/url]

There'll be more Clive in the future, so stay tuned! In the meantime, if you want something more polished and plot-centric, I highly recommend my other title 'Bane Murrain'. I'm working on a full rework before it's next episode and it's pretty huge!
[i](Oh yeah and the plot's connected, as per usual with all my stuff)[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2625340/Bane_Murrain/

Anyway I'm gonna get back to work on shiz. Have a great week everyone!
- Elias
